label: New number
what_it_sounds_like: Hi Mum, it's me. My phone broke, so this is my new number.
Can you save this one? My old number doesn't work any more.
why_it_works: It explains the strange number before you have time to wonder about it, and a broken phone is everyday bad luck that anyone could have.
what_to_do: Say you'll ring them straight back, hang up, and call the number you already have for them. If it really is them, they won't mind at all.

label: Urgency
what_it_sounds_like: It has to be done today, I can't explain right now.
I need it in the next ten minutes or it's too late.
why_it_works: A rush leaves no room to think, and a calm moment of thinking is usually all it takes to notice something is off.
what_to_do: Slow down on purpose. Anything real can wait five minutes while you check. Hang up and call back on a number you know.

label: Secrecy
what_it_sounds_like: Please don't tell Dad yet, I'll explain everything later.
Can we keep this between us? It's a bit embarrassing.
why_it_works: Keeping it quiet stops you from talking to the very people who would say it doesn't sound right.
what_to_do: Treat a request for secrecy as a reason to tell someone. Ring another relative, or the family number, before you do anything.

label: Authority
what_it_sounds_like: Hello, this is the security team at your bank.
I'm calling from the police fraud team about your account.
why_it_works: Most of us are polite to officials and want to help them, so it feels natural to follow their lead.
what_to_do: Thank them, hang up, and call the organisation yourself on the number on your card, a letter or their official website. A real one will understand.

label: Emotional appeal
what_it_sounds_like: I'm so stressed, you're the only one I can ask.
Please, I really need you to help me out this once.
why_it_works: When someone we love sounds upset, we want to make it better quickly, and that kindness can rush us past our usual care.
what_to_do: You can be kind and still check. Ask for the family word, or say you'll call them right back on their usual number.

label: Small ask first
what_it_sounds_like: Can you just confirm your date of birth for me?
Before anything else, could you check the text I just sent?
why_it_works: Saying yes to something small makes the next, bigger request feel like part of the same friendly chat.
what_to_do: You don't owe a caller any detail, however small. Ask who they are, hang up, and call back on a number you trust.

label: Don't call anyone
what_it_sounds_like: Don't ring the bank, someone there might be involved.
Please don't call anyone else about this yet.
why_it_works: It cuts you off from the people who would gently tell you it sounds like a scam.
what_to_do: Anyone who tells you not to check is exactly the one to check. Call a relative or the family number straight away.

label: Unusual payment
what_it_sounds_like: Could you buy some gift cards and read me the numbers?
Send it to my friend's account, mine is blocked.
why_it_works: Gift cards, vouchers, crypto and couriers are quick and hard to undo, which is exactly why they get asked for.
what_to_do: Never pay with gift cards, vouchers, crypto or a courier because a caller asked. Hang up and talk it over with family first.

label: Asks for money
what_it_sounds_like: Could you send me a few hundred euros today?
I'll pay you back tomorrow, I just need it now.
why_it_works: Money is what most of these calls are about; the whole story is built to lead up to the ask.
what_to_do: Let any request for money be your cue: hang up and call the person back on the number you already have.

label: Asks for a code
what_it_sounds_like: We've just texted you a code, can you read it out to me?
To cancel the payment I need your PIN, just to confirm it's you.
why_it_works: A code or PIN is the key to your account; whoever has it can act as you.
what_to_do: Never read out a code, PIN or password to someone who called you. Nobody genuine needs it on a call, not your bank and not family.

label: Avoids a call-back
what_it_sounds_like: No, don't hang up, we'll lose the connection.
There's no time for the family word, just help me.
why_it_works: A real caller is happy for you to check. Someone pretending can't afford to let you.
what_to_do: If they push back on a call-back or the family word, that tells you enough. Hang up calmly and call back on a number you know.
